inputBoundary: One already-derived finite dwell duration in minutes at an already-identified source-defined partying location.
outputBoundary: Discard the partying-location dwell below 30 minutes and retain it at or above 30 minutes; equality is retained.
limitations: This binding does not identify Greek houses, dorms, or other behavioral spaces as partying locations.
This binding does not reconstruct visits or derive their dwell durations.
This binding does not apply the source day-of-week condition.
This binding does not partition a retained dwell into 10-minute windows.
This binding does not derive audio or activity attributes or perform the source k-means partying classification.
A missing or non-finite partying-location dwell duration fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
